name: @yakit-libs/yakit-ui
description: Yakit React component library with a version-matched offline Storybook.

scripts.build:lib: pnpm run generate:color-css && vite build --mode lib && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && node scripts/release/fix-declaration-imports.mjs
scripts.test:ssr-fixtures: vitest run --config vitest.node.config.ts test/icons/icon-ssr-fixture.test.ts test/icons/solid-icon-ssr-fixture.test.ts test/icons/oldicon-contract.test.ts test/ssr/native-components-ssr.test.tsx
scripts.test:ci: pnpm run test:ssr-fixtures && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --exclude test/components/solid-icon-visual.test.tsx
scripts.release:dry-run: pnpm run test:release && pnpm run build:package && pnpm run verify:package && pnpm run pack:dry-run
scripts.lint: eslint src config scripts .storybook test/icons test/components test/fixtures test/ssr test/types vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts vitest.node.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src config scripts .storybook test/icons test/components test/fixtures test/ssr test/types vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts vitest.node.config.ts --fix
scripts.test:audit-icons: vitest run --config vitest.node.config.ts test/icons/audit-icons.test.ts test/icons/baseline-integrity.test.ts test/icons/solid-baseline-integrity.test.ts test/icons/icon-figma-names.test.ts test/icons/icon-registry-names.test.ts test/icons/icon-storybook-contract.test.ts test/icons/icon-script-coverage.test.ts test/icons/icon-audit-determinism.test.ts test/icons/colorful-audit-determinism.test.ts test/icons/colorful-contracts.test.ts test/icons/colorful-entry-generator.test.ts test/icons/colorful-color-resolver.test.ts
scripts.test:icon-transform: vitest run --config vitest.node.config.ts test/icons/icon-transform.test.ts test/icons/icon-ssr-fixture.test.ts test/icons/solid-fragment-normalization.test.ts test/icons/solid-icon-ssr-fixture.test.ts test/icons/colorful-fragment-normalization.test.ts && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/components/icon-fragment-runtime.test.tsx test/components/icon-public-runtime.test.tsx test/components/solid-icon-fragment-runtime.test.tsx test/components/solid-icon-public-runtime.test.tsx test/components/colorful-icon-fragment-runtime.test.tsx test/components/colorful-icon-public-runtime.test.tsx
scripts.test:icon-dist-consumer: pnpm run build:lib && vitest run --config vitest.node.config.ts test/icons/dist-consumer.test.ts
scripts.test:icon-package-contract: tsc -p test/types/tsconfig.public.json --noEmit && vitest run --config vitest.node.config.ts test/icons/light-entry-contract.test.ts test/icons/dedicated-package-contract.test.ts
scripts.test:icon-visual: vitest run --config vitest.node.config.ts test/icons/outline-pixel-metrics.test.ts test/icons/icon-paint-semantics.test.ts test/icons/solid-paint-semantics.test.ts && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/components/icon-visual.test.tsx test/components/solid-icon-visual.test.tsx
scripts.test:icons:solid: vitest run --config vitest.node.config.ts test/icons/solid-baseline-integrity.test.ts test/icons/solid-paint-semantics.test.ts test/icons/solid-fragment-normalization.test.ts test/icons/solid-icon-ssr-fixture.test.ts && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/components/solid-icon-public-runtime.test.tsx test/components/solid-icon-fragment-runtime.test.tsx test/components/solid-icon-visual.test.tsx && pnpm run test:types
scripts.audit:icons:outline: node scripts/audit-icons.mjs --check --policy outline-v1 --manifest scripts/figma-outline-icons-inventory.json --index src/icons/outline/index.tsx --name-catalog src/icons/figmaNameCatalog.ts --outline-name-manifest scripts/figma-outline-icons-inventory.json --outline-name-index src/icons/outline/index.tsx --outline-name-raw-provenance test/fixtures/icons/reference/figma-outline-raw-provenance-v1.json --outline-name-placement-provenance test/fixtures/icons/reference/figma-outline-placement-provenance-v1.json --solid-name-manifest scripts/figma-solid-icons-inventory.json --solid-name-index src/icons/solid/index.tsx --solid-name-raw-provenance test/fixtures/icons/reference/figma-solid-raw-provenance-v1.json --solid-name-placement-provenance test/fixtures/icons/reference/figma-solid-placement-provenance-v1.json
scripts.audit:icons:solid: node scripts/audit-icons.mjs --check --policy solid-v1 --manifest scripts/figma-solid-icons-inventory.json --index src/icons/solid/index.tsx --name-catalog src/icons/figmaNameCatalog.ts --outline-name-manifest scripts/figma-outline-icons-inventory.json --outline-name-index src/icons/outline/index.tsx --outline-name-raw-provenance test/fixtures/icons/reference/figma-outline-raw-provenance-v1.json --outline-name-placement-provenance test/fixtures/icons/reference/figma-outline-placement-provenance-v1.json --solid-name-manifest scripts/figma-solid-icons-inventory.json --solid-name-index src/icons/solid/index.tsx --solid-name-raw-provenance test/fixtures/icons/reference/figma-solid-raw-provenance-v1.json --solid-name-placement-provenance test/fixtures/icons/reference/figma-solid-placement-provenance-v1.json --figma-raw-provenance test/fixtures/icons/reference/figma-solid-raw-provenance-v1.json --placement-provenance test/fixtures/icons/reference/figma-solid-placement-provenance-v1.json
scripts.audit:icons: pnpm run audit:icons:outline && pnpm run audit:icons:solid && pnpm run audit:icons:colorful
